decisions.decision: Committee to use the next scheduled meeting to finalize the program priorities and decide which programs are included in the project.
decisions.quote: decided to use the next scheduled meeting to finalize the priorities to determine which programs should be included in the project.

decisions.decision: Conference Room #3 becomes tables and chairs storage and is made smaller, letting Conference Room #4 expand.
decisions.quote: it was agreed that conference room #3 should become tables and chairs storage and could be smaller, allowing conference room #4 to expand.

decisions.decision: The existing gravel area to the north is to be turned into a formal parking area.
decisions.quote: it was determined that the existing gravel area to the north should be turned into a formal parking area.

decisions.decision: Landscaping to be provided in the gravel-area parking lot so it does not look like a large parking lot; angled parking added across from the library and existing parallel spaces eliminated.
decisions.quote: landscaping is to be provided in the parking lot in the gravel area so that there is not a large parking lot appearance.

decisions.decision: Committee members will make final decisions about the conference rooms at their next meeting.
decisions.quote: committee members will make final decisions about the conference rooms during their next meeting.

decisions.decision: Staff/design team to evaluate the program to identify duplicate spaces and streamline space use, including reducing archival storage and reviewing redundant spaces.
decisions.quote: committee suggested to evaluate program to identify duplicate spaces and streamline space use.

decisions.decision: Greg Roy to send MAI the drainage report and associated plans for the Middle/High School.
decisions.quote: greg roy is going to get mai the drainage report and associated plans for the middle/high school.
